label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: Tab order starts with a Dismiss announcement button and then walks through every header nav item twice (a button and a separate span with the same name for Apparel, Accessories, Groceries), costing about 12 Tab presses before the first product.

After opening a product from the home page the page title was empty and the page was blank until I re-read it, and keyboard focus was not moved to the top or the main content; my first Tab landed in the footer.

The colour buttons are only named by colour and discount (Pure blue, 27% off) and the size buttons do not say that sizes 39, 43, 44, 45 are unavailable; I had to guess from missing discount text. The big Select options button could not be reached by keyboard until both options were chosen.

Choosing a colour or size drops keyboard focus (nothing focused, back to top of page), so after each choice I had to Tab backwards from the footer many times to find the next control. Add to bag also drops focus, and its result is only visible as a changed cart count, not announced.

The image gallery puts 4 thumbnail buttons plus previous or next buttons between the header and the size options, and focusing each one changes the slide, so the cart button is about 20 Tab presses away from the Add to bag button.

Checkout opens with focus on a generic div, not the first field; the Contact section has the Log in button before the email field, and two unchecked checkboxes (create account, news and offers) sit between email and address. The country list with about 250 entries is read out as page text, and the form needs about 15 Tab stops plus typing, so I ran out of steps before reaching the Continue to shipping button and the payment step.

events.thought: Only 3 steps left, the payment step cannot be reached in that budget, so I stop honestly.

findings.problem: Tab order starts with a Dismiss announcement button and then walks through every header nav item twice (a button and a separate span with the same name for Apparel, Accessories, Groceries), costing about 12 Tab presses before the first product.

After opening a product from the home page the page title was empty and the page was blank until I re-read it, and keyboard focus was not moved to the top or the main content; my first Tab landed in the footer.

The colour buttons are only named by colour and discount (Pure blue, 27% off) and the size buttons do not say that sizes 39, 43, 44, 45 are unavailable; I had to guess from missing discount text. The big Select options button could not be reached by keyboard until both options were chosen.

Choosing a colour or size drops keyboard focus (nothing focused, back to top of page), so after each choice I had to Tab backwards from the footer many times to find the next control. Add to bag also drops focus, and its result is only visible as a changed cart count, not announced.

The image gallery puts 4 thumbnail buttons plus previous or next buttons between the header and the size options, and focusing each one changes the slide, so the cart button is about 20 Tab presses away from the Add to bag button.

Checkout opens with focus on a generic div, not the first field; the Contact section has the Log in button before the email field, and two unchecked checkboxes (create account, news and offers) sit between email and address. The country list with about 250 entries is read out as page text, and the form needs about 15 Tab stops plus typing, so I ran out of steps before reaching the Continue to shipping button and the payment step.
